$doc: Load budgets from project/archive/2026-09-22-load-perf.md §1 (re-set 2026-09-23 for E44 — each re-set row says why), checked by `pnpm bench:ci` (scripts/bench-load.mjs --ci). cond = <network>/<cold|warm>; metric = a row field of progress/bench/*.json; max (with unit MB|s|count) or equals. Missing rows print n/a and do not fail. A row with `shard` checks that shard's runs only (the `chunk=` of --query; a row without one is Driftwood Isle's, the default boot). Pine Hollow's rows (PINE-HOLLOW-REMASTER PH-P3) are the phone tier: `node scripts/bench-load.mjs --ci --viewport=390x844 --cache=cold,warm "--query=chunk=pine-hollow&tier=phone&mute=1"`.

rows.name: first-launch transfer
rows.why: 2026-09-23 E44 (project/archive/2026-09-23-preload-offline.md): every audio file (3 music styles + every SFX set, ~11.9 MB) and the title art (~2 MB) now load at the bar — the user picked completeness over cold bytes; Driftwood measured 16.1 MB (was ≤ 12 MB)

rows.name: requests, first launch
rows.why: E44: the ~135 audio / art files are fetched one by one so a style / set switch and an offline launch read each from the SW cache; Driftwood measured 161 (was ≤ 20)

rows.name: time to play, cold
rows.why: E44: +14 MB at Fast 4G's 9 Mbit/s is ~13 s; Driftwood measured 19.5 s (was ≤ 10 s). The launch the player repeats is the warm one below

rows.name: time to play, warm
rows.why: E44: L1 / P5 now target the cached launch; it decodes the selected music style + SFX set from the cache before playable. Measured 3.3–3.8 s on a loaded host where 015861d read 3.1 s (was ≤ 3 s)

rows.name: Pine Hollow first-launch transfer (phone)
rows.why: PH-U18 → PH-U26 → PH-U33 (Jake, 2026-09-25: accept ~36 MB, every music style stays at the bar — E44): the photoreal shard's full kit — sky keys, the Blender species set, the crags + cave, the generated creatures, all three music styles + the SFX sprite. Measured 36.01 MiB (a9eac35: after dropping the other shards' landscape art + Driftwood's own sounds from Pine Hollow's bar); the row allows 37 MiB.

rows.name: Pine Hollow requests, first launch
rows.why: measured 160 on 2026-09-25 (55612c9: Pine Hollow's 63 one-shots + barks are ONE audio sprite, scripts/music/gen/sfx_sprite.py); 228 on its parent 7fb39f2, over the row, after the audio-wiring lane put the set on the bar one file at a time (151 before that)

rows.name: Pine Hollow time to play, cold (phone)
rows.why: ~34 MB at Fast 4G's 9 Mbit/s is ~31 s of transfer alone; measured 35.1 s (55612c9) — re-set with the 35 MB transfer row (Jake, 2026-09-25)

rows.name: Pine Hollow time to play, warm (phone)
rows.why: measured 5.2 s. The row is wifi's: the bench's 4g/warm run used to re-download the boot pack (13–17.5 MB net) — on a 4G first visit the pack went out before the SW controlled the page, so the SW never stored it. Fixed 2026-09-25 (E158: src/boot/pack.ts hands such a part to the SW, sw.js STORE): 4g/warm measured 0.00 MB net, play 6.2 s

rows.name: Pine Hollow longest main-thread task
rows.why: a ceiling, not a target: measured 1.05 s, the `menu` step's task (title art · explore) — Driftwood's is the same task (1.15 s against its 100 ms row)

rows.name: Pine Hollow service worker controls warm run
